notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
•    Fixed various colliders that would cause the player to become stuck
•    Various UI fixes
•    Edited outfit pickups to make it clearer what the player can do with them
•    Various optimization efforts

notes.title: Lingering Legacy Official Bug Report Form
notes.notes:
Good afternoon community! We have put together a form so that you can submit bugs that you find. This way we can streamline getting everything polished and create a better experience for you! The development team is working very hard to make sure everything is up to your expectations!

Please use this link to submit any and all bugs! 
[url=https://forms.gle/gEuCoQXytqyJHbJ86]Lingering Legacy Official Bug Report Form[/url]

If you have any larger issues with the game feel free to contact us directly at
lingeringlegacy@gmail.com and a team member will be with you as soon as possible!

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:

notes.title: Lingering Legacy is Live Now!
notes.notes:
Thank you all so much for bearing with us through all the errors and delays. We are extremely excited to announce that Lingering Legacy is now live and ready for purchase! We wanted to thank so many people so please check them out below!

TheReluctantHermit: https://www.twitch.tv/thereluctanthermit
TheReluctantHermit voiced all of our male characters in our game, promoted it on his Twitch, helped grow our community, and helped us meet so many of you. Without him, the game would not have the reach that it does. 

TheRavenArmed: https://www.twitch.tv/theravenarmed  Thank you so much for promoting our game and getting it in front of new eyes. It was so fun being able to see people chat about the game and get excited about it! Thank you so much for the help and all of your support!

To our Dev Team, Artists, Voice Actors, and Alpha/Beta Testers: This has been a very long two-year journey. Multiple team members have changed throughout the development process, we have overcome various setbacks, and have finished this fantastic game during a worldwide pandemic. I am extremely proud of everyone who has worked on this team and made this game come to life in ways we never could have imagined at the beginning!

To our families: thank you for understanding that we were working day in and day out to make our own dreams come true. We made the decision to open our own door and you understood that. Thank you for taking care of us, supporting us, and being the best fans we could ask for.
